title: CCELL Palm Pro 510 Battery
description:
Experience unparalleled convenience and performance with the CCELL Palm Pro 510 Battery, a game-changer in the world of vaping. Engineered for those who prioritize ease and quality, the Palm Pro simplifies your vaping journey from the moment you drop in the cartridge. Its sleek dimensions (2.26H x 1.65W x 0.53D inches) make it a compact powerhouse, while the 500mAh battery ensures long-lasting use. Featuring a standard 510 thread, it’s compatible with a wide range of cartridges, making it a versatile choice for enthusiasts.

The Palm Pro stands out with its customizable vaping experience. With three voltage settings (2.8/3.2/3.6V), adjustable airflow control, and a 10-second pre-heat function, it delivers rich flavours and dense clouds from the first puff — a must-have feature, especially in colder conditions. The intuitive airflow collar allows for easy adjustment of suction resistance, ensuring a smooth draw tailored to your preferences.

This 510 cartridge battery is not only inhale activated for ease of use but also includes a drop-in magnetic connection for secure cartridge attachment. Monitoring your battery life is effortless with the 3-bar battery status LED, and when it’s time to recharge, the Type-C charging port offers quick and convenient power-ups.

Included in your purchase are the CCELL Palm Pro 510 Battery, a USB-C Cable, and two Magnetic Connectors, providing everything you need for an outstanding vaping experience. Whether you’re at home or on the go, the CCELL Palm Pro Battery delivers reliability, customization, and satisfaction. Elevate your vaping with the CCELL Palm Pro 510 Battery — where technology meets taste.
